title: Point-aware vs chip-EV push/fold tables, larger confirmation run (NLHE, full 8-player SNGs)
description: Same arms as endgame-points-vs-chips with fresh seeds, 16 validation lineups and four times the blocks. Declared before running: the discovery run was inconclusive with a negative point estimate (-0.36, MDE 0.79), so the question is only the sign; min_effect 0 means B must beat A with the interval excluding zero.
